import json, sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp/dev')
from harness import *

MIB = 1024 * 1024
LOG_MAX = 96 * MIB
LINE_MAX = 4096
LINES_MAX = 300000

m = {"version":1,"seed":17,"low_count":1,"attempts":1,"spacing_ms":1000,"timeout_ms":1000000,
     "windows":[{"id":"w","start_ms":0,"scopes":[{"id":"s","prefix":"2001:db8::/64","subnets":[0]}]}]}
mp = wmanifest(m)
good_row = {"probe_id":"w/s/0/low-1/0","received_ms":0,"target":"2001:db8::1","source":"2001:db8::1","type":129,"code":0}
gj = json.dumps(good_row)

def log_ok(name, data):
    def fn():
        p = wf('big.jsonl', data)
        rep = run_ok(['replay', mp, p])
        assert rep['accepted_rows'] + len(rep['diagnostics']) > 0
    check('log ok: ' + name, fn)

def log_bad(name, data):
    def fn():
        p = wf('big.jsonl', data)
        run_bad(['replay', mp, p])
    check('log bad: ' + name, fn)

# --- line length limits ---
log_ok('line 4095 + LF', gj[:-1] + ' ' * (4095 - len(gj) + 0) + '\n' if False else b'x' * 4095 + b'\n')
log_bad('line 4096 + LF', b'x' * 4096 + b'\n')
log_ok('last line 4096 no LF', b'x' * 4096)
log_bad('last line 4097 no LF', b'x' * 4097)
log_ok('CRLF 4094+CR+LF', b'x' * 4094 + b'\r\n')
log_bad('CRLF 4095+CR+LF', b'x' * 4095 + b'\r\n')
log_ok('valid row padded to 4095+LF', (gj[:-1] + ' ' * (4095 - len(gj))).encode() + b'\n')
log_ok('empty file', b'')
log_ok('single LF', b'\n')
log_ok('single row no LF', gj.encode())

# --- line count limits ---
log_ok('exactly 300000 lines', b'\n' * LINES_MAX)
log_bad('300001 lines', b'\n' * (LINES_MAX + 1))
log_ok('300000 rows of valid json', (gj + '\n').encode() * LINES_MAX)
def fn():
    p = wf('big.jsonl', (gj + '\n').encode() * LINES_MAX)
    rep = run_ok(['replay', mp, p])
    assert rep['accepted_rows'] == 1 and rep['duplicate_rows'] == LINES_MAX - 1, (rep['accepted_rows'], rep['duplicate_rows'])
    assert rep['diagnostics'] == []
check('300000 duplicate rows counted', fn)

# --- size limits ---
log_ok('exactly 96 MiB', b'x' * LOG_MAX)
log_bad('96 MiB + 1', b'x' * (LOG_MAX + 1))
def fn():
    # 96 MiB made of 4096-byte lines: 24576 lines
    data = (b'x' * 4095 + b'\n') * (LOG_MAX // 4096)
    assert len(data) == LOG_MAX
    p = wf('big.jsonl', data)
    run_ok(['replay', mp, p])
check('96 MiB of max lines ok', fn)

# manifest size limits already covered; re-check replay path uses them
def fn():
    run_bad(['replay', wf('m2.json', ' ' * (MIB) + json.dumps(m)), wf('r2.jsonl', b'')])
    run_bad(['replay', wf('m3.json', ' ' * (MIB + 1) + json.dumps(m)), wf('r3.jsonl', b'')])
    run_ok(['replay', wf('m4.json', ' ' * (MIB - len(json.dumps(m))) + json.dumps(m)), wf('r4.jsonl', b'')])
check('manifest size limit on replay path', fn)

# unreadable / missing log
def fn():
    run_bad(['replay', mp, '/workspace/tmp/dev/t/missing.jsonl'])
    run_bad(['replay', mp, WORK])
check('unreadable log', fn)

sys.exit(report())
